name: Bestway Marine & Energy Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Bestway Marine & Energy Technology Co.,Ltd provides marine and offshore engineering research and design services in China and internationally. The company operates through Marine Engineering, Defense Equipment, and New Energy segments. It offers dry bulk carriers, oil and chemical tankers, feeder containers, ships, and other transport vessels.
